name: aina
description: aina: the AI notch for Windows (Rust + Tauri 2)

scripts.icon: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/brand-icon.ps1 && tauri icon crates/aina-app/icons/source.png -o crates/aina-app/icons
scripts.dev: node scripts/build-wake.mjs && node scripts/sync-ui.mjs && tauri dev
scripts.build: node scripts/build-wake.mjs && node scripts/sync-ui.mjs && tauri build
scripts.build:msix: node scripts/build-wake.mjs && node scripts/sync-ui.mjs && tauri build --no-bundle && node scripts/build-msix.mjs
